Since crash_date is DATE typed, empty strings, unknown words, and impossible dates cannot be represented in the field.
data_check.meaning_and_decisions: The date filter leaves no in-range crash rows out for missing or sentinel dates. All requested years have observed records at both calendar boundaries, so no year appears partial by the available date bounds. Keep all in-range rows; the boundary check is evidence about observed date bounds, not an independent completeness audit.
data_check.changes: No change to the initial plan.

final_plan.denominator: None; raw crash-row counts over the requested 2013–2025 period
final_plan.population: One row per police-reported NYC motor vehicle crash with crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025 inclusive (2,132,218 rows)
